name: remix_camera_companion_image
description: Preview or generate Remix.Camera companion images for selfies, chat-context snaps, outfits, couple photos, vacation sets, date photos, daily-life snaps, and private snaps. Preview first unless the user explicitly confirms generation.

prompt.description: Short scene, mood, or user request.

sourceImageUrl.description: Source image URL for outfit/reference workflows.

userReferenceImageUrl.description: User reference photo URL for couple workflows.

userConsent.description: Affirmative consent for user-in-image workflows. Use yes only when explicit.

yes.description: Set true only after explicit confirmation to spend a generation.

preview.description: Set true to force a dry-run preview.
